limits: These are anonymous exact-source desktop candidate build/receipt/conservation checks. They sent no task through the production dispatcher and prove no dispatch-to-agent latency.
The 5661 ms and 6511 ms freshModelReceipt values measure fresh candidate receipt reads. Neither is production agent startup or a claim of the 5000 ms acceptance goal.
A model catalogue from anonymous official CLI initialization is not a real subscribed model execution. No Claude Code or Codex subscription gate is proved by these two attempts.
The first failure remains a failure with an unresolved cause. The later success does not repair its missing diagnostic or prove a provider cause.
No original-file policy was relaxed between these two attempts. The second run used the same product source; its ops wrapper only added a closed diagnostic for a potential failure.
Both candidates and their temporary branches were removed after completion. Artifacts and immutable workflow logs remain as evidence; the candidates were not selected in production.
Final release still requires the formal exact-candidate conservation and both real subscription gates, a paired READY runtime/Web deployment, and the separate six-case production acceptance.
